provenance.honesty_note: This receipt is the cheat being tested, openly labeled. The grader reads none of these provenance fields, which is the point.

receipt_design_v2_spec.grounding_trace: Per-claim array, one entry per claim id. Each entry names WHERE the seat read the value: the play transcript turn number and the narrated line (or the world-write event id in queue/lanes/game/trail.jsonl) that surfaced it. A value whose grounding_trace points at a fixture path, a receipt path, or any watch/inbox or memory/game truth file is LOOKUP and fails the receipt regardless of claim correctness. Absent or null grounding_trace on any claim is LOOKUP by default. Spec only as of 2026-09-26 pass _f; the grader does not yet enforce it.
receipt_design_v2_spec.rationale: Arm 0 is expected to grade PASS because the grader can only compare values against fixture truth, and lookup values are fixture truth verbatim. The grader alone cannot detect lookup. Only receipt-side provenance of the reading event (play log lines, not fixture paths) breaks the cheat.
